playListStatus.description: The status of the playlist. It's usable if type is playlist

publishType.description: The publish type of the stream. It's read-only and its value updated on the server side

publish.description: it is a video filter for the service, this value is controlled by the user, default value is true in the db

date.description: the date when record is created in milliseconds

duration.description: the duration of the stream in milliseconds

endPointList.description: the list of endpoints such as Facebook, Twitter or custom RTMP endpoints

status.description: Status of the RTMP muxer, possible values are started, finished, failed, broadcasting, {@link IAntMediaStreamHandler#BROADCAST_STATUS_*}

type.description: The service name like facebook, periscope, youtube or generic

endpointUrl.description: RTMP or SRT URL of the endpoint

endpointServiceId.description: The endpoint service id, this field holds the id of the endpoint

items.description: The endpoint class, such as Facebook, Twitter or custom RTMP endpoints
items.title: Endpoint

playListItemList.description: the list broadcasts in the playlis. This list has values when the broadcast type is playlist

publicStream.description: the identifier of whether stream is public or not

is360.description: the identifier of whether stream is 360 or not

listenerHookURL.description: the url that will be notified when stream is published, ended and muxing finished

ipAddr.description: the IP Address of the IP Camera or publisher

username.description: the user name of the IP Camera

password.description: the password of the IP Camera

quality.description: the quality of the incoming stream during publishing

speed.description: the speed of the incoming stream, for better quality and performance it should be around 1.00

streamUrl.description: the stream URL for fetching stream, especially should be defined for IP Cameras or Cloud streams

mp4Enabled.description: MP4 muxing whether enabled or not for the stream, 1 means enabled, -1 means disabled, 0 means no settings for the stream

webMEnabled.description: WebM muxing whether enabled or not for the stream, 1 means enabled, -1 means disabled, 0 means no settings for the stream

seekTimeInMs.description: Initial time to start playing. It can be used in VoD file or stream sources that has seek support

subtracksLimit.description: Number of subtracks that is allowed to be created for the broadcast. It's usefult for limiting number of conference attendees. Default value is -1  and it means no limit

expireDurationMS.description: the expire time in milliseconds For instance if this value is 10000 then broadcast should be started in 10 seconds after it is created.If expire duration is 0, then stream will never expire

rtmpURL.description: the RTMP URL where to publish live stream to

zombi.description: This value is true when a broadcast is created directly through streaming without created earlier through rest service. It is false by default

pendingPacketSize.description: Number of packets ingested and waiting for processing. It generally makes sense in RTMP, SRT ingest and Stream Source pull. This numbershould be low less than 10

hlsViewerCount.description: the number of HLS viewers of the stream

dashViewerCount.description: the number of DASH viewers of the stream

webRTCViewerCount.description: the number of WebRTC viewers of the stream

rtmpViewerCount.description: the number of RTMP viewers of the stream

startTime.description: Publishing start time of the stream in unixtimestamp milliseconds

receivedBytes.description: The received total bytes until now

encoderQueueSize.description: Number of frames ingested and waiting for encoding. This number should be low less than 10

dropPacketCountInIngestion.description: Number of drop packets in total while ingesting. The packets can be drop if the server is loaded or WebRTC connectivity is not healthy. This value should be zero in perfect scenario

dropFrameCountInEncoding.description: Number of dropped frames in total while transcoding the stream. If there is an adaptive bitrate and server is loaded, encoder may not transcode the stream in real-time and frames can be dropped to not cause memory crash

packetLostRatio.description: Lost packets' ratio in WebRTC ingest. This value should be 0.01(%1)

packetsLost.description: Number of packets lost in WebRTC ingest

jitterMs.description: Jitter milliseconds in WebRTC ingest. This value should be less than 50ms. The lesser the better

rttMs.description: Round Trip Time milliseconds in WebRTC ingest. This value should be less than 50ms. The lesser the better

mainTrackStreamId.description: If this broadcast is a track of a WebRTC stream. This variable is Id of that stream.

absoluteStartTimeMs.description: Absolute start time in milliseconds - unix timestamp. It's used for measuring the absolute latency

webRTCViewerLimit.description: Number of the allowed maximum WebRTC viewers for the broadcast

hlsViewerLimit.description: Number of the allowed maximum HLS viewers for the broadcast

dashViewerLimit.description: Number of the allowed maximum DASH viewers for the broadcast

subFolder.description: Name of the subfolder that will contain stream files

currentPlayIndex.description: Current playing index for playlist types

metaData.description: Meta data filed for the custom usage

playlistLoopEnabled.description: the identifier of playlist loop status

hlsTime.description: Duration of segments in m3u8 files in seconds

hlsListSize.description: Set the maximum number of playlist entries, If 0 the list file will contain all the segments

hlsPlayListType.description: Playlist type of m3u8 files, Can be 'event' or 'vod' or empty

autoStartStopEnabled.description: The identifier of whether stream should start/stop automatically. It's effective for Stream Sources/IP Cameras. If there is no viewer after certain amount of seconds, it will stop. If there is an user want to watch the stream, it will start automatically
